en: CF CMS (package cf-cms) is an open-source multilingual blog and CMS on the Cloudflare free tier — Pages Functions, D1, R2, and Workers AI — with public routes for zh, en, ja, es, and ar (Arabic is RTL); the admin UI and admin APIs are only at /<ADMIN_SAFEPATH>/admin/ (ADMIN_SAFEPATH is a random secret created by setup, plain /admin returns 404, and the login session is still required on that path); connect its MCP server by posting JSON-RPC to /mcp with header Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_API_TOKEN (local stdio proxy: npm run mcp with CF_CMS_URL) and use tools project_info, list_posts, get_post, create_post, update_post, publish_post, unpublish_post, delete_post, list_tags, upsert_tag, delete_tag, list_channels, upsert_channel, delete_channel, get_settings, get_site_copy, update_site_copy, get_sections, update_sections, update_template, update_layout, update_meta, update_share, update_brand, upload_logo, generate_visual_kit, list_media, upload_media, and delete_media to read the project and manage drafts, published posts, tags, channels, site and per-post meta, per-language site copy (homepage headline, footer line, About page), portal landing sections, template, layout, share links, logo, favicon, theme color, visual kits, and R2 media.
zh: CF CMS（包名 cf-cms）是跑在 Cloudflare 免费套餐上的开源多语言博客与 CMS，使用 Pages Functions、D1、R2 和 Workers AI，公开路由为 zh、en、ja、es、ar（阿拉伯语从右到左）；后台页面和后台接口只在 /<ADMIN_SAFEPATH>/admin/（ADMIN_SAFEPATH 由安装脚本随机生成，直接访问 /admin 会返回 404，到达该路径后仍要登录会话）；把 MCP 连到 /mcp，请求头使用 Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_API_TOKEN（本地 stdio 代理是设置 CF_CMS_URL 后执行 npm run mcp），并用 project_info、list_posts、get_post、create_post、update_post、publish_post、unpublish_post、delete_post、list_tags、upsert_tag、delete_tag、list_channels、upsert_channel、delete_channel、get_settings、get_site_copy、update_site_copy、get_sections、update_sections、update_template、update_layout、update_meta、update_share、update_brand、upload_logo、generate_visual_kit、list_media、upload_media、delete_media 阅读站点并管理草稿、发布、标签、栏目、站点与文章 meta、分语言站点文案（首页标题、页脚、关于页）、门户落地区块、模板、版式、分享链接、标志、favicon、主题色、视觉套件和 R2 媒体。
